**ACCEPT** — governed in-seat review of PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/7677, head `a7dfbcca` (skills seat, 2026-09-04T22:3xZ).

Verified in a detached compare worktree at the PR head, not from the report: four published guides, 9 insertions / 11 deletions, every hunk a one-line correction of a shipped-API fact to what the built `dist/*.d.ts` declares — `AuthProvider` takes `client` (and the required `authUrl`), at both sites; `createAuthenticatedFetch()` takes its options, not the client; `PermissionGuard`'s `fallback` is the closed union and the element moves to `fallbackContent`; the four i18n format helpers are module exports of `@object-ui/i18n` taking options objects, so the import, the destructure and the `formatDate` call all change together; `usePullToRefresh` returns an object whose `ref` is destructured; `MetadataProvider` takes `adapter`. No fence rewritten, no marker added, no package source touched. The dev's per-site differential diagnostics (the named TS code present before and absent after, the residue being placeholder-only) are the verification the seat relies on — one corrected fence (`auth-permissions.md`'s fetch example) now compiles clean, the first unmarked guide fence that does; corpus semantic failures 81 → 80. Gates on the tree: `check-changeset-presence` (no changeset owed — objectui's decider), `check-control-bytes`, `check-skills-paths` exit 0; the dev's report adds `check:skill-examples` unchanged at 13/70 (both floors kept), `check:skill-eval-tokens`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:governed-queue-guard` green; net −2 lines. PR checks at the head: 22 success, 3 skipped, 3 still running, none failed. PR body starts `Fixes #7676`, six-row 改前 → 改后 table with the differential evidence, no model identifier; dev report first on this card with the literal `os-dev-report` line; zero MCP calls.

Residue, accepted without a card: the now-clean fetch fence could be opted into the marker (13 → 14); ruling A on objectui#7675 keeps the guides prose-first, and a single marker is not worth a governed PR of its own — it rides on the next guide correction that touches that file.

Landing regime: governed (`skills/**`) ⇒ the PR **stays a draft**; reviewers `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested in this same act; human merge.
